mapper.select: SELECT app.id AS application_id, app.form_id, app.status, app.submitted_at, ans.value ->> 'text' AS name FROM applications app LEFT JOIN fields f ON f.space_id = app.space_id AND f.event_id = app.event_id AND f.form_id = app.form_id AND f.system_key = 'NAME' LEFT JOIN answers ans ON ans.space_id = app.space_id AND ans.event_id = app.event_id AND ans.application_id = app.id AND ans.field_id = f.id WHERE app.space_id = #{spaceId} AND app.event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT app.id AS application_id, app.form_id, app.status, app.submitted_at, CAST(NULL AS text) AS name FROM applications app WHERE app.space_id = #{spaceId} AND app.event_id = #{eventId} AND app.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY app.submitted_at ASC, app.id ASC

SELECT a.application_id, a.field_id, a.value::text AS value FROM answers a JOIN applications app ON app.space_id = a.space_id AND app.event_id = a.event_id AND app.id = a.application_id WHERE a.space_id = #{spaceId} AND a.event_id = #{eventId} AND app.status = 'SUBMITTED'
